description: Soften any photo with an adjustable blur radius, previewed live.

faqs.a: The radius slider goes from 0 to 20 pixels; the blur is applied with your browser's canvas blur filter.
faqs.q: How strong can the blur be?

faqs.a: Blur uses the browser's built-in canvas blur filter. It is fast, but at very large radii it is an approximation, not an exact Gaussian.
faqs.q: Is the blur a true Gaussian?

faqs.a: A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Drag the blur radius slider to preview the effect live.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Blur Tool
